FINANCIAL PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT OF THB SECOND SCHEDULE)
Order, 1970

WHEREAS it is provided under sub-section (4) of section 10 of the

62 of 1957.     Financial Procedure Ordinance, 1957, that the House of Representatives
may from time to time by resolution amend, delete, or add to the
Second Schedule thereto;

AND WHEREAS Parliament was dissolved on the twentieth day of
ep ge     March, 1969;

AND WHEREAS section 2 of the. Emergency (Essential Powers)
Ordinance No. 6, 1969, provides that the extension, force or effect of
any written law may be effected by an order made under the hand of
the Director of Operations designated under section 2 of the Emergency
(Essential Powers) Ordinance No. 2, 1969, published in the Gazette;

NOW THEREFORE, the Director of Operations designated under section
2 of the ‘Emergency (Essential Powers) Ordinance No. 2, 1969, hereby
makes the following order:

1. This order may be cited as the Financial Procedure (Amendment of Citation.
the Second Schedule) Order, 1970.
